"""Behavioural tests for the replay engine (run in-process)."""
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.engine import run_request


BASE_TOPO = {
    'nodes': [
        {'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 100},
        {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 100},
    ],
    'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 100}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
BASE_SETTINGS = {
    'trials': 2, 'epsilon': 0, 'seed': 7, 'cutoff': [0, 1],
    'bias': 0, 'tau': 0, 'gamma': [1, 1], 'cache_slots': 2,
}
PATHS = {
    'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 1000}]},
    'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 1000}]},
}
FULL_COUNTERS = {
    'low_A_egress_to_B': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_B_ingress_from_A': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_B_egress_to_A': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_A_ingress_from_B': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_A_termination': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_B_origination': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_B_termination': {'perturbed': 10},
}
FULL_DEMANDS = [[0, 1, 10], [1, 0, 3]]

failures = []


def check(name, got, expected):
    if got != expected:
        failures.append(name)
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got     ', json.dumps(got))
        print('  expected', json.dumps(expected))
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


def run(events, topo=BASE_TOPO, settings=BASE_SETTINGS):
    return run_request({'streams': [{'topology': topo, 'settings': settings,
                                     'events': events}]})


def ev(index):
    return run_results['streams'][0]['events'][index]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- patch rules
def t_patch_rules():
    good = {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [], 'counters': {}}
    check('empty patch', run([good])['streams'][0]['events'],
          [{'op': 'patch', 'accepted': True}])
    cases = {
        'extra field': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [], 'counters': {}, 'x': 1},
        'missing counters': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': []},
        'demands wrong type': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': {}, 'counters': {}},
        'counters wrong type': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [], 'counters': []},
        'entry not list': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [5], 'counters': {}},
        'entry short': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1]], 'counters': {}},
        'entry long': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 1, 1]], 'counters': {}},
        'entry float': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 1.0]], 'counters': {}},
        'entry bool': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, True]], 'counters': {}},
        'pair same node': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 0, 1]], 'counters': {}},
        'pair unknown node': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 9, 1]], 'counters': {}},
        'pair non external': {
            'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 1]],
            'counters': {}},
        'pair repeated': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 1], [0, 1, 2]],
                          'counters': {}},
        'value negative': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, -1]], 'counters': {}},
        'value too big': {'op': 'patch',
                          'demands': [[0, 1, 1000000001]], 'counters': {}},
        'unknown key': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                        'counters': {'low_Z_origination': {'perturbed': 1}}},
        'cell not object': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                            'counters': {'low_A_origination': 5}},
        'cell list': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                      'counters': {'low_A_origination': [1]}},
        'cell missing perturbed': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                                   'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'ground_truth': 3}}},
        'cell extra field': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                             'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 1, 'zzz': 2}}},
        'perturbed float': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                            'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 1.5}}},
        'perturbed bool': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                           'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': True}}},
        'perturbed over cap': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                               'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 101}}},
        'perturbed negative': {'op': 'patch', 'demandms': [],
                               'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': -1}}},
        'perturbed str': {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
                          'counters': {'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 'x'}}},
    }
    for name, bad in cases.items():
        out = run([bad])
        check('reject: ' + name, out['streams'][0]['events'],
              [{'op': 'patch', 'accepted': False}])
    # accepted cells with ignored annotations of any shape
    ok = {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [],
          'counters': {'low_A_origination': {
              'perturbed': None, 'ground_truth': [1, {'x': None}],
              'corrected': 'zz', 'confidence': 0.5}}}
    check('annotations ignored', run([ok])['streams'][0]['events'],
          [{'op': 'patch', 'accepted': True}])

    # atomicity: rejected patch after accepted one leaves state alone
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'x', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'one'},
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 99]], 'counters': {
            'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 500}}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'two'},
    ]
    global run_results
    run_results = run(events)
    first = ev(2)
    second = ev(4)
    check('atomic state (no change)', second['links'], first['links'])
    check('atomic state cache hit', second['cache_hit'], True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cache rules
def t_cache():
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'p'},          # miss
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'q'},          # hit (same key)
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'r'},          # miss (demand changed)
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10]], 'counters': {}},  # back to first
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 's'},          # hit (same as first key)
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [], 'counters': {'low_A_egress_to_B': {
            'perturbed': 10, 'ground_truth': 999}}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 't'},          # hit: annotation is not identity
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'different label', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'u'},          # hit: label is not identity
    ]
    out = run(events)
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('cache hit sequence', hits, [False, True, False, True, True, True])

    # LRU eviction with two slots
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},      # miss, cache = [K1]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'},      # miss, cache = [K1, K2]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 12]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'c'},      # miss, evict K1 -> [K2, K3]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'd'},      # miss (K1 evicted)
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'e'},      # hit (K2 still cached)
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 12]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'f'},      # hit? K3 was refreshed at 'e'? no
    ]
    out = run(events)
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    # LRU order after b: [K1,K2]; c evicts K1 -> [K2,K3]; d inserts K1 evicting K2
    # -> [K3,K1]; e (K2) miss -> evict K3 -> [K1,K2]; f (K3) miss.
    check('lru eviction', hits, [False, False, False, False, False, False])
    # recency refresh on hit
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},                     # K1 miss
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'},                     # K2 miss
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 12]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'c'},                     # K3 miss evict K1
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'd'},                     # K1 miss evict K2
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'e'},                     # K2 miss evict K3
    ]
    out = run(events)
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('lru no refresh path', hits, [False] * 5)
    # hit refreshes recency
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},                     # K1
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'},                     # K2 -> [K1,K2]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'c'},                     # hit K1 -> [K2,K1]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 12]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'd'},                     # K3 evicts K2 -> [K1,K3]
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'e'},                     # hit K1
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'f'},                     # K2 miss
    ]
    out = run(events)
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('lru refresh on hit', hits, [False, False, True, False, True, False])

    # zero slots: always miss
    settings = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings['cache_slots'] = 0
    out = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'}], settings=settings)
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('zero slots', hits, [False, False])
    check('zero slots same result',
          out['streams'][0]['events'][3]['links'],
          out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'])

    # route identity: splitting weighted entries changes the key
    split = {
        'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 500},
                    {'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 500}]},
        'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 1000}]},
    }
    out = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'b', 'paths': split},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'}])
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('route identity by multiset', hits, [False, False])
    # bundle order / path order irrelevant
    reordered = {
        'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 500},
                    {'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 500}]},
        'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 500},
                    {'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 500}]},
    }
    out = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': split},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'b', 'paths': reordered},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'b'}])
    hits = [e['cache_hit'] for e in out['streams'][0]['events']
            if e['op'] == 'repair']
    check('route order irrelevant', hits, [False, True])

    # validation settings are not identities
    settings2 = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings2['cutoff'] = [1, 4]
    settings2['tau'] = 5
    settings2['gamma'] = [2, 7]
    settings2['cache_slots'] = 4
    out = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
               {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
               {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'}])
    out2 = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
                {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
                {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'}], settings=settings2)
    check('validation settings not identity',
          out2['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'],
          out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'])

    # repair settings are identities
    settings3 = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings3['seed'] = 8
    out3 = run([{'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS,
                 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
                {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
                {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'a'}], settings=settings3)
    check('seed changes repair',
          out3['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'] !=
          out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'], True)


# ------------------------------------------------------------- snapshots
def t_snapshots():
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'one'},
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 50]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'one'},
    ]
    out = run(events)
    check('validate uses current demands',
          out['streams'][0]['events'][4]['checked'], 8)
    check('validate failed keys sorted',
          out['streams'][0]['events'][4]['failed'],
          sorted(out['streams'][0]['events'][4]['failed']))
    # frozen data is not modified by later repairs under other ids
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'one'},
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 40]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'two'},
        {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'one'},
    ]
    out = run(events)
    v = out['streams'][0]['events'][5]
    check('snapshot survives later repair', v['checked'], 8)
    # replacing a snapshot id
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'x'},
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 40]], 'counters': {}},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'x'},
        {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'x'},
    ]
    out = run(events)
    check('snapshot replaced', out['streams'][0]['events'][5]['passed'], 8)

    # null routes: external expectations only
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'n'},
        {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'n'},
    ]
    out = run(events)
    check('null routes validate external only',
          out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['checked'], 4)


# ------------------------------------------------------------- validation
def t_validation():
    # cutoff filtering: confidence 3 and 5 -> cutoff 4 checks only internal
    events = [
        {'op': 'patch', 'demands': FULL_DEMANDS, 'counters': FULL_COUNTERS},
        {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'a', 'paths': PATHS},
        {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'one'},
        {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'one'},
    ]
    settings = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings['cutoff'] = [4, 1]
    out = run(events, settings=settings)
    v = out['streams'][0]['events'][3]
    check('cutoff filters cells', v['checked'], 4)
    check('cutoff consistent null?', v['consistent'], True)
    # gamma gate
    settings = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings['gamma'] = [1, 1]
    out = run(events, settings=settings)
    check('gamma inclusive', out['streams'][0]['events'][3]['consistent'], True)
    # tau inclusive comparison
    settings = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings['tau'] = 0
    out = run(events, settings=settings)
    check('tau zero', out['streams'][0]['events'][3]['passed'], 8)
    # bias scales expectation
    settings = dict(BASE_SETTINGS)
    settings['bias'] = 1000000
    out = run(events, settings=settings)
    v = out['streams'][0]['events'][3]
    # Y = pred * 0 = 0; X = corrected*1e6 -> passes only when corrected == 0
    check('bias full', v['passed'], 0)
    # empty stream of flows
    empty_topo = {'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 5}],
                  'links': [], 'external_nodes': []}
    out = run([{'op': 'repair', 'id': 'e'}, {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'e'}],
